description: This file defines the interface for the ec_manager_t class, which acts as a dispatcher and handler for EasyConnect (EC) in a Wi-Fi mesh network. It includes methods for onboarding, handling DPP frames, security key management, and managing connections between nodes (both configurator and enrollee). It references various external classes and functions related to Wi-Fi configuration, security, and frame processing.

classes.name: ec_manager_t
classes.description: A class that manages EC operations such as onboarding, frame handling, security management, and connection management for Wi-Fi nodes within the EasyConnect protocol.

methods.name: ec_manager_t
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EC manager with device address, callbacks, control flags, security context, and handshake handler.

methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.
